task.goal: Add the recipes from recipes.txt in Markor that take 3 hrs to prepare into the Broccoli recipe app.
task.final_summary: I added the three recipes from recipes.txt in Markor that have a 3 hrs preparation time to the Broccoli app: Chicken Caesar Salad Wrap (8 servings), Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken (2 servings), and Avocado Toast with Egg (2 servings). Each was saved and read back on its own detail page with the time, servings, description, ingredients and directions matching the file exactly, and all three now appear in the recipes list.
